summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, opposing any proposal to eliminate or sunset it. The school district expresses concerns about the cost burden of E-Rate on their budget and urges the FCC to preserve and improve the program rather than sunset or eliminate it.

claims.argument: The FCC’s proposal to eliminate E-Rate would have a direct and tangible impact on school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: We receive $12,000 in internet reimbursement each school year. This is more than my total technology budget.
